research.name: listr2
research.note: Node.js task list renderer that redraws a nested tree of concurrent tasks in place with spinners and status icons.

effects: nested task tree redrawn in place with per-task spinners for concurrent subtasks
subtasks collapse into the parent line once the parent completes
per-state icons: check for done, down arrow with [SKIPPED] for skipped, red cross for failed, square for pending
live task output shown as an indented line under the running task and as a bottom bar line
